name: Chris Murphy

lean.basis: Democratic Connecticut legislator, congressman (2007–2013) and U.S. senator since 2013; argues for an aggressively populist Democratic Party.

race_2028.basis: Launched the American Mobilization PAC in June 2025 to fund anti-Trump organizing; NBC News wrote that he sounds like someone eyeing a 2028 bid, though he has denied laying groundwork for one.

summary: Chris Murphy has been a Democratic U.S. senator from Connecticut since 2013, after three terms in the House. Since the 2024 election he has become one of the most prominent Democratic critics of Trump, using social media heavily and a super PAC (the American Mobilization PAC) to fund opposition organizing; he is discussed as a possible 2028 presidential candidate.
